sources.entry: Aleph - Tool for indexing large amounts of both documents (PDF, Word, HTML) and structured (CSV, XLS, SQL) data for easy browsing and search. It is built with investigative reporting as a primary use case. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Aleph is an open-source tool for indexing and searching large collections of documents (PDF, Word, HTML) and structured data (CSV, XLS, SQL), built for investigative reporting, and it is being sunset by its maintainers after December 2025.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Aleph as a tool for indexing large amounts of documents such as PDF, Word and HTML files, and structured data such as CSV, XLS and SQL, so they can be browsed and searched. It is built with investigative reporting as its primary use case. Aleph can cross-reference mentions of well-known entities, such as people and companies, against watchlists from prior research or public datasets. Installation, usage and data import details are in external documentation that the README links to. The README does not list further features in detail.
use_cases: index and search large document collections
search PDFs, Word files and HTML pages together
cross-reference people and companies against watchlists
browse structured CSV, XLS or SQL data alongside documents
how_to_run: See the external installation documentation linked in the README (no commands given in the README itself)
The awesome-selfhosted listing indicates Docker and Kubernetes deployment
notable: Cross-references entities such as people and companies against watchlists
Covers both unstructured documents and structured datasets in one index
Designed with investigative reporting as the primary use case
Default branch 'develop' holds unstable code; stable releases are on main or in the releases list
caveats: Project status is SUNSETTING: maintenance ends December 31, 2025, with no updates, bug fixes or core-team support after that date
Core team has moved development to a rewritten commercial platform, Aleph Pro
The default develop branch contains unreleased, unstable code
